newsitem.title: USA: U.S. condemns "barbaric" killings in Chechnya.
newsitem.headline: U.S. condemns "barbaric" killings in Chechnya.

text.p: The United States on Tuesday condemned as "barbaric" the murders of six international Red Cross workers in Chechnya and called on Chechen authorities to find the killers.

"We are very, very disturbed about the report that six medical workers from the International Committee of the Red Cross were killed in their sleep," State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns told reporters.
"It's a barbaric act and we are condemning it in the strongest possible terms," Burns said, "and we call upon the Chechen authorities...to do everything they can to track down the murderers."
Burns said Washington had "great sympathy" with the ICRC's reported inclination to suspend its operations in Chechnya. He said the United States would continue to support the ICRC.

"You cannot have international relief organisations work in these conditions where people who are there objectively to help both sides are gunned down in the most cruel and merciless fashion," Burns said.
Masked gunmen stormed into an ICRC compound in Novye Atagi village southwest of the capital Grozny and shot dead six Western staff on Tuesday.
